segments.name: Electric utility
segments.evidence: SCE is an investor-owned public utility primarily engaged in the business of supplying and delivering electricity to an approximately 50,000 square mile area across Southern, Central and Coastal California.

revenueModel.text: SCE earns revenue from customers through regulated electric rates that allow timely recovery of its costs.
revenueModel.evidence: SCE's overall cash flows fluctuate based on, among other things, its ability to recover its costs in a timely manner from its customers through regulated rates
